scripts.generate: npm run build && npx firebase emulators:exec --export-on-exit=../.firestore-data 'node dist/run-generator.js main'
scripts.generate:no-emulator: npm run build && FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:18080 node dist/run-generator.js
scripts.generate:level1: npm run build && npx firebase emulators:exec --export-on-exit=../.firestore-data 'node dist/run-generator.js level1'
scripts.generate:level2: npm run build && npx firebase emulators:exec --export-on-exit=../.firestore-data 'node dist/run-generator.js level2'
scripts.generate:level3: npm run build && npx firebase emulators:exec --export-on-exit=../.firestore-data 'node dist/run-generator.js level3'
scripts.generate:level4: npm run build && npx firebase emulators:exec --export-on-exit=../.firestore-data 'node dist/run-generator.js level4'
scripts.generate:all-levels: npm run generate:level1 && npm run generate:level2 && npm run generate:level3 && npm run generate:level4
